title: Maize — Fertilizer and Nutrient Management
content:
MAIZE FERTILIZER RECOMMENDATION:

FOR HIGH-YIELDING HYBRIDS (8-10 t/ha target):
Total N: 180 kg/ha | P2O5: 60 kg/ha | K2O: 40 kg/ha

APPLICATION SCHEDULE (3-way split):
1. BASAL (at sowing): N 60 kg/ha + P 60 kg/ha + K 40 kg/ha + ZnSO4 25 kg/ha
2. TOP DRESS 1 (knee-high stage, 25-30 DAS): N 60 kg/ha (as urea 130 kg/ha)
3. TOP DRESS 2 (tasseling, 50-55 DAS): N 60 kg/ha (as urea 130 kg/ha)

FOR OPV VARIETIES:
N: 120 kg/ha | P: 50 kg/ha | K: 30 kg/ha (same 3-split pattern)

ZINC:
- ZnSO4 25 kg/ha as basal is essential in most Karnataka soils.
- Deficiency causes striped leaves (white stripes on younger leaves).

FOLIAR SPRAY:
- Urea 1% spray if leaf yellowing observed (N deficiency).
- ZnSO4 0.5% spray if zinc deficiency.

ORGANIC MATTER:
- FYM 10 t/ha or Poultry manure 2.5 t/ha at land preparation.
- Reduces inorganic fertilizer requirement by 25%.

SOIL TYPE:
- Best in well-drained loam/sandy loam soils. pH 6.0-7.5.
- Maize is sensitive to waterlogging — very poor performance in heavy clay soils.
- Avoid low-lying poorly drained fields.

KARNATAKA (UAS Dharwad recommendation):
- Kharif maize: N:120, P:60, K:40 kg/ha for OPV; N:180, P:75, K:50 for hybrids.
- Apply FYM 10 t/ha + 25 kg ZnSO4 at land preparation.
